title: Might or Might Not Meet Your Needs
text: Might or Might Not Meet Your Needs. I had some corrosion along the inside of the microwave door below the level of the inside of the over itself, along the bottom of the door...it was open apparently to microwave resulting in sparking and the like. That area was then 'burning' the other side of the inside of the over along the bottom. I used the product to prevent this from re-curring but to know avail. It worked maybe one time but it was going to take more than a thing coating. After about 3 days there was an even bigger 'flare up' and the hole-wearing away then was much worse and as a result the product was to no avail, the oven despite that other wise worked perfectly and was fine in every other way, had to be trashed for a new one. I only, as such, used the product (about a 1/3 of it) before it was of no use. In the end, I guess it will depend on what one's issue is with their particular over and how bad it is. I can't speak/write from anything but my own experience - I can imagine for some this product might at least temporarily held, but the inevitable in my situation was at hand (even though it was only a small area), it was the nature of the problem that was the real issue - one that this product couldn't handle.
